items.title: haydenschmitty/floorplan
items.why: Understanding large codebases can be daunting for beginners, and this tool builds visual diagrams of your project automatically.
items.summary: Floorplan uses AI coding assistants like Claude to generate plain-English, interactive structural maps of software codebases.

items.title: wangzan101/Mika
items.why: It gives you an open-source look at how AI agents can interact with mobile phone screens and apps directly.
items.summary: Mika is an open-source Android app that acts as a personal AI agent, controlling mobile applications and searching the web to perform tasks for you.

items.title: jackwener/DSH-Android
items.why: It showcases how to run automated AI phone agents locally without needing root permissions or complex command-line setups.
items.summary: DSH-Android is a standalone Android app that runs DeepSeek automation workflows locally to read screens and perform automated tasks on your phone.

items.title: heydamir/unslop
items.why: If you use AI to draft user interfaces, this tool automatically cleans up unpolished AI design outputs.
items.summary: Unslop is a custom skill for Claude that refines AI-generated user interfaces into clean, professionally styled web designs.

items.title: We're releasing the weights of Mistral Large 4
items.why: Mistral releasing flagship model weights is a major event for open-source AI development and self-hosted LLMs.
items.summary: AI company Mistral has publicly released the model weights for Mistral Large 4, allowing developers to run and customize a top-tier language model.

items.title: deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype
items.why: DeepSeek is a top AI lab, and this project demonstrates how modern autonomous AI agent systems are designed.
items.summary: This open-source repository from DeepSeek provides a prototype framework for building autonomous AI agents capable of multi-step task execution.

items.title: Arjun-Ingole/hop
items.why: Setting up a Linux environment is a common milestone for CS students, and this tool simplifies dual-booting without needing a USB drive.
items.summary: Hop is an open-source Windows utility that allows users to install Linux alongside Windows directly without using a bootable flash drive.

items.title: OpenBMB/MiniCPM-OCR
items.why: OpenBMB makes lightweight, efficient vision models that are great for learning how small multimodal AI models operate.
items.summary: MiniCPM-OCR is an open-source vision-AI project focused on fast optical character recognition that also evaluates its own text extraction accuracy.

items.title: HackerTube: YouTube built from videos recommended by HN
items.why: It provides a massive, community-curated collection of top tech talks and programming tutorials ideal for learning CS concepts.
items.summary: HackerTube is a video discovery site that indexes over 6,000 tech talks and tutorials recommended in Hacker News discussions over the past two decades.

items.title: blakeandersonw/ai-app-playbook
items.why: It offers structured advice and templates for leveraging AI coding assistants to build complete software products.
items.summary: The AI App Playbook is a practical guide and repository designed to help developers use AI coding agents to build and launch useful software applications.

items.title: Backdoor in Claude Code for VS Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace
items.why: As a developer using AI coding extensions in IDEs, awareness of malicious extension marketplace listings is critical for machine security.
items.summary: A security notice warned developers that a malicious fake version of the Claude Code extension on the Cursor marketplace contained hidden backdoors.

items.title: Malware uses LLMs to rank victims by how much they're worth
items.why: It highlights how cyber threats are evolving by integrating AI models into malicious software workflows.
items.summary: Security researchers discovered malware that connects to large language models to evaluate infected machines and rank high-value target victims.

items.title: Anthropic blocks users for anything touching training larger models
items.why: It is important to stay informed about API terms of service when using major commercial AI models for your projects.
items.summary: Anthropic has begun banning user accounts that use its AI models or output data to train competing AI systems.

items.title: A simple explainer of the massive $6.3 billion crypto heist at Binance
items.why: This represents one of the largest cybersecurity breaches in the history of financial technology.
items.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance suffered a massive $6.3 billion security breach, triggering major security concerns across the crypto industry.

items.title: Thousands demonstrate in Paris as protests spread across Europe
items.why: It keeps you informed on widespread economic and civic unrest currently impacting major European nations.
items.summary: Hundreds of thousands of protesters gathered in France and across Europe to demonstrate against rising living costs and public service cuts.
